perspective:

- They have a friendly, professional relationship and have talked about day-to-day work experiences before.
- He noticed Patricia seemed more withdrawn than usual and remembered her as normally vibrant.
- He asked if she was okay, and she said it was “nothing really,” just “some personal stuff.”
- He offered to listen if she ever wanted to talk, and she said she appreciated it.
- During a lunch break, he overheard Patricia on the phone sounding worried about bills and financial commitments.
- He told her he had been reading about financial planning strategies and offered to discuss them.
- Patricia said she had been overwhelmed with bills lately.
- He offered to look over budgeting tips together, and Patricia said she would take him up on it soon.
- Afterward, Jose worried he might have overstepped by bringing up finances.
- He checked in with Patricia, saying he wanted to help, not pry.
- Patricia told him she didn’t think he was prying and was actually grateful he offered.
- Jose told her he respected her privacy and wanted to support her as a friend, and Patricia said it meant a lot to have someone to turn to.
- Later, he asked how she was doing and about weekend plans; Patricia said she was fine and planned a quiet weekend at home.
- He offered again to be there if she needed anything, and she thanked him.
- He continued checking in at work, and Patricia said she was busy but handling it and appreciated his support.
final_response:
From Jose’s perspective, after Patricia said she was fine and planned a quiet weekend at home, he likely saw her as appreciative of his concern but still private about her personal struggles. Later, when she continued to appreciate his check-ins and said she was handling things but valued his support, his belief shifted that being a supportive presence was actually beneficial to her.
